title: Ergodicity of the voter model with dynamic anti-voter bonds
summary: The voter model with anti-voter bonds is a variant of the classical voter model in which the edges of the underlying graph are assigned signs. At each update, a voter chooses a neighbour according to a transition kernel; interactions across a positive edge follow the usual voter dynamics, so that a site adopts the current opinion of its chosen neighbour, whereas interactions across a negative edge lead to the adoption of the opposite opinion.
